name: november-frontend
description: November micro frontends: a shell host and three Module Federation remotes

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shell,payments,approvals,incoming --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @november/shell" "npm run dev -w @november/payments" "npm run dev -w @november/approvals" "npm run dev -w @november/incoming"
